results.notes: owslib.wfs.WebFeatureService parsed a live WFS 2.0.0 capabilities document titled 'Honua WFS 2.0' with 5 feature types.

Transport verified as plain http on the compose client-compat network, which terminates no TLS. TLS handshake behaviour is exercised in the release tier, where the same lane runs against the HTTPS candidate.

Anonymous GET /api/v1/admin/services -> 401, WWW-Authenticate: ApiKey realm="Honua Admin", header="X-API-Key". The WFS data surface is anonymous in this fixture, so the control plane substantiates the AUTH facets.
Accepted scheme x-api-key -> 200; ladder: x-api-key=200
WebFeatureService.contents listed 5 namespace-qualified feature types: ['honua:test_layer', 'honua:browser_points', 'honua:browser_lines', 'honua:browser_polygons', 'honua:portal_public_points'].
honua:test_layer: title='Test Layer', CRS options ['EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857'], WGS84BoundingBox (-122.5, 37.7, -122.35, 37.84) encloses the seeded feature envelope [-122.49, 37.71, -122.37, 37.79].

owslib.feature.schema.get_schema parsed DescribeFeatureType into 14 typed properties; every seeded attribute is present with its XSD type (int/double/boolean/dateTime/date/time), and objectid is non-nillable.
The XSD types the 'shape' element as a GML PointPropertyType, which OWSLib maps to the fiona geometry 'Point' -- matching the seeded Point layer.
An owslib.fes2 PropertyIsEqualTo Filter Encoding 2.0 document posted as XML matched 5 of 10 features (status='active'); every returned feature carries the value.

A 5-element BBOX carrying an explicit urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84 selected 3 features (['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma']); OWSLib formats the ordinates in the CRS's declared axis order and the server honours it.
OWSLib maps maxfeatures=3 to the WFS 2.0 COUNT parameter; the server returned 3 members while reporting the full numberMatched=10.
STARTINDEX=3 returned ['delta', 'epsilon', 'zeta'] after ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'].
Anchor 'alpha' returned (-122.49, 37.71) in the GeoJSON output format (RFC 7946 longitude/latitude, so no axis ambiguity) against seeded (-122.49, 37.71); deviation 0.0 degrees, threshold 1e-06.
SRSNAME=urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326 is echoed verbatim on every gml geometry and the ordinates follow that CRS's declared latitude/longitude order (gml:pos=[37.71, -122.49]).
OWSLib raised owslib.util.ServiceException from a spec-shaped ows:ExceptionReport with exceptionCode=InvalidParameterValue, locator=typeNames and the offending type name in the text.

A syntactically valid Filter Encoding 2.0 document referencing an unknown ValueReference is rejected with an ows:ExceptionReport carrying exceptionCode=InvalidParameterValue rather than silently returning every feature.

extensions.notes: OperationsMetadata advertises 27 entries covering every mandatory WFS 2.0 operation, and GetFeature offers both ['get', 'post'] DCP bindings.

Capabilities declare the WFS 2.0 conformance constraint set including ImplementsBasicWFS, ImplementsResultPaging, KVPEncoding and XMLEncoding; the paging and encoding claims are exercised by the paging and POST-filter cases.

All 5 advertised GetFeature output formats returned real payloads: application/gml+xml; version=3.2=1707B, GML3.2=1671B, application/geo+json=518B, text/csv=375B, application/json=518B. An advertised-but-unservable format is a capabilities lie.
DescribeFeatureType returned a well-formed XSD declaring 'test_layer' in the gml:AbstractFeature substitution group and importing GML 3.2.

The 4-element BBOX (default CRS, longitude/latitude) and the 5-element CRS84 BBOX select the identical feature set ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'], so the server's bbox axis-order handling matches OWSLib's.
fes:PropertyIsGreaterThan on the integer `count` column returns exactly the three rows above 7; a lexical comparison would mis-order 10.
propertyname=['name','status'] narrowed the payload to exactly those two columns, and the PROPERTYNAME=* wildcard widened it back to all 13 properties.
SORTBY=name returned all 10 features in ascending name order.
RESULTTYPE=hits reported numberMatched=10 with numberReturned=0 and no wfs:member elements, which is what a client uses to size a query before fetching.
A COUNT=3 walk produced 10 distinct gml:id values summing exactly to numberMatched: no gaps, no repeats, stable ordering across pages.
4 (CRS, spelling) combinations from the advertised crsOptions were served, each labelled with a matching srsName and reprojected within tolerance.

Every deliberate client error produced an ows:ExceptionReport OWSLib could parse: bad-srsname=InvalidParameterValue, structurally-invalid-filter=InvalidParameterValue, unknown-property-projection=InvalidParameterValue, unsupported-output-format=InvalidParameterValue. None returned a 500 or a silently empty FeatureCollection.

OWSLib WebFeatureService negotiated WFS 1.0.0, parsed capabilities, discovered honua:test_layer, and executed GetFeature; EPSG:4326 coordinate (-122.49, 37.71) obeyed that version's axis-order contract.

OWSLib WebFeatureService negotiated WFS 1.1.0, parsed capabilities, discovered honua:test_layer, and executed GetFeature; urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326 coordinate (37.71, -122.49) obeyed that version's axis-order contract.

OWSLib's bare getfeature() (which sends PROPERTYNAME=*) works on both legacy versions. WFS 1.0.0 -> srsName EPSG:4326 with longitude/latitude [-122.49, 37.71]; WFS 1.1.0 -> srsName urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326 with latitude/longitude [37.71, -122.49]. The per-version axis-order rule is honoured in both directions.

WFS and OGC API - Features agree on the same layer: extent (-122.5, 37.7, -122.35, 37.84), numberMatched 10, and every WFS-advertised EPSG code [3857, 4326] is also offered by the OGC API collection [3857, 4326].

ListStoredQueries advertises 1 queries including the mandatory urn:ogc:def:query:OGC-WFS::GetFeatureById; invoking it through OWSLib's storedQueryID/storedQueryParams returned the requested feature test_layer.1.
